limitations.sourceForm: setNMIExclusive in the selected C64 profile
limitations.reason: The approved private-home-free exclusive route has proved idle-entry CIA2 source ownership, immutable links, direct output and four-profile timer/RESTORE/boundary VICE behavior with vector-first final handback. External aggregate stack, retained-firmware completion, physical behavior and general startup preservation remain unproved; this bounded qualification does not grant raw takeover or arbitrary prior-source ownership.
limitations.decision: RD-05 CIA2 ownership plan AR-P2/AR-P3; independent source/storage/output qualification and 568 native cases without skips. RD-05/DEF-7, keyboard coexistence and mandatory R5.4 startup-state repair remain open. VICE-verified / hardware-unverified.

limitations.sourceForm: balanced setNMI/restoreNMI in the selected C64 profile
limitations.reason: The approved private-home-free generated stock-chained route passes storage, immutable-link, actual output and four-profile genuine-source VICE qualification. Per-entry storage and stack facts are proved; external aggregate stack, unrestricted nesting and complete retained-firmware completion remain unproved and are not promised.
limitations.decision: RD-05 cooperative NMI plan AR-P11; independent source, storage, output and genuine-source VICE qualification; exclusive takeover and remaining DEF-7 obligations stay RD-05-owned

limitations.sourceForm: setIRQ, setIRQExclusive, or restoreIRQ reached during IRQ-handler execution
limitations.reason: Balanced handler-side IRQ updates have finite root-specific ownership, private storage and saved links; source, output and VICE qualification pass. An unmatched restore still fails with E10278.
limitations.decision: RD-05 handler-IRQ plan AR-P3; independent source, storage, output and VICE qualification

limitations.decision: Phase 6 RV-010 fixed and independently re-reviewed in Phase 9; stack-overlap, stack-overlap-contexts, stack-nonreturn, stack-mask-boundary and stack-mask-return specification tests

limitations.reason: Native asset handlers now deliver loadable unit bytes through the RD-07 packager. The retired restriction was the resident-only handler boundary; the replacement probe builds a loadable native asset successfully.
limitations.decision: RD-07 delivered native loadable units; the ledger probe uses the synthetic SPD fixture and must build

limitations.sourceForm: setSpritePointer with more than one distinct vicScreenSelect screen
limitations.reason: The frozen setSpritePointer API has no screen argument. A unique compile-time screen base is required for a layout-derived pointer table; a program that selects two distinct screens cannot be resolved without a per-call screen relation. The rejection fails closed rather than writing the wrong table.
limitations.owner: T-27 follow-up / issue #140; future per-call screen relation
limitations.decision: RD-06 residual plan; single active screen is supported, multi-screen pointer-table selection remains tracked debt

limitations.sourceForm: an interrupt function that retains a masked or sampled value across consumers or volatile reads, or materializes a Boolean from a bit test whose mask is computed at runtime, whose operand is a 16-bit word whose high byte can be nonzero, whose word value comes from a byte read needing zero-extension staging, or whose comparison is against a nonzero constant
limitations.reason: The cooperative NMI route admits no invocation-private RAM or zero-page homes. A masked value shared by several consumers and several simultaneously retained samples are live across later operations and have no bounded retention mechanism on this route. A 16-bit word mask can set the high byte, so it needs two masked bytes and a join or temporary. A runtime word local from a byte read stages its zero-extension low byte in a private home. A computed mask needs a temporary before the AND, so the read cannot stay in A. A comparison against a nonzero constant is outside the selected zero-test materialization. The compiler fails closed rather than guessing.
limitations.decision: Issue #149 delivered the remaining materialization forms: constant masks 8+ and multi-bit masks through the expert inline branch, the zero-mask fold, the all-ones load identity, an addressable runtime mask, a byte-masked word (identity, shift or branch by mask), and a single-use constant local, with zero private storage and expert-equal or better output. The remaining forms need bounded storage, a wider join, a zero-extension staging proof, an addressable computed mask or a general comparison branch; they are tracked by issue #150.
